title: Count Distinct Elements in Every Window
statement:
Given an array of N integers and a window size K, print the number of distinct elements in each contiguous window of size K.

There are N-K+1 such windows.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: N-K+1 space-separated integers: the count of distinct elements in each window.

examples.explanation: Every window of size 2 has only one distinct element.
